idea.title: One listing, five places
idea.angle: Most of your audience never sees a single Instagram post. Put the same listing on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, WhatsApp and property sites, each in the shape that fits.
idea.hook: ONE LISTING. FIVE PLACES. NOT ONE.

slides.heading: ONE LISTING. FIVE PLACES. **NOT ONE**.
slides.body: Most of your buyers never see that one post.

slides.heading: YOUR BUYERS AREN'T ALL ON **INSTAGRAM**
slides.body: Some scroll TikTok. Some live on WhatsApp. Some only check property sites. Post in one place, and the rest never see it.

slides.heading: INSTAGRAM: **REEL** PLUS PHOTOS
slides.body: Post your 15-second video as a Reel. Add a photo carousel for buyers who like to swipe.

slides.heading: TIKTOK: THE **SAME** VIDEO
slides.body: No new work. Post the same 15-second video, upright, with captions you can read with the sound off.

slides.heading: FACEBOOK: PAGE AND **GROUPS**
slides.body: Post it on your Page. Then share it in local groups where people look for homes.

slides.heading: WHATSAPP: STATUS AND **BROADCAST**
slides.body: Put the video on your Status. Then send it to your broadcast lists of past buyers and contacts.

slides.heading: PROPERTY SITES: THE **FULL** DETAILS
slides.body: Use your sideways photos here. Add every detail: bedrooms, bathrooms, price and location.

caption:
One post on Instagram is not enough. Most of your buyers will never see it.

Your buyers are spread out: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, WhatsApp and property sites.
You don't need new content for each one.
Use the same video and photos, in the shape each place likes.
One listing, five places, more people seeing it.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.

idea.title: First slide: weak hook vs strong hook
idea.angle: Text-only before/afters: 'House for sale' becomes '4-bed with a pool'. 'Apartment available' becomes 'Quiet 2-bed near the mall'.
idea.hook: YOUR FIRST LINE: BEFORE AND AFTER

slides.heading: YOUR FIRST LINE: **BEFORE** AND AFTER
slides.body: One line decides if they stop.

slides.heading: "HOUSE FOR SALE" SAYS **NOTHING**
slides.body: Buyers decide in about a second whether to keep looking. A plain first line gives them no reason to stop.

slides.heading: THE **FAMILY** HOME
slides.body:
Before: "House for sale."
After:
✓ "4-bed with a pool, quiet street"
✓ The size comes first
✓ One standout feature
✓ A reason to stop

slides.heading: THE CITY **APARTMENT**
slides.body:
Before: "Apartment available."
After:
✓ "Quiet 2-bed near the mall"
✓ Says how big it is
✓ Says where it is
✓ Says why it's nice to live in

slides.heading: THE **RENTAL**
slides.body:
Before: "Nice house for rent. DM for info."
After:
✓ "3-bed family home, close to schools"
✓ Speaks to the right renter
✓ Answers their first question

slides.heading: WHAT A STRONG FIRST LINE **HAS**
bullets: Size: the bedroom count, house or apartment.
Area: the street, or what's close by.
Standout: a pool, a garden or a view.

slides.heading: SAME LISTING. ONE BETTER **LINE**.
slides.body: Put it on your first photo and in the first 3 seconds of your video.

slides.heading: WRITE A FIRST LINE THAT **STOPS** THEM

caption:
"House for sale" is not a hook. It's a label.

Buyers decide in about a second whether to keep looking.
Your first line has to tell them why this home is worth their time.
Say the size, the area or the standout feature.
"4-bed with a pool, quiet street" stops people. "House for sale" doesn't.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.

idea.title: The buyer messaged 3 agents. Who won?
idea.angle: I tell it from the buyer's side: she sees a city apartment, messages three agents, and books with whoever answers first. Speed often beats the best listing.

slides.heading: SHE MESSAGED **3 AGENTS**. WHO WON?
slides.body: Not the one with the best listing.

slides.heading: SHE FINDS A CITY **APARTMENT**
slides.body: Say she sees three similar 2-bed apartments, from three agents. She likes all of them. So she messages all three.

slides.heading: REPLIES THE **NEXT DAY**
slides.body: A long, friendly message. Great photos too. But she has already booked a viewing somewhere else.

slides.heading: REPLIES IN **3 HOURS**
slides.body: "Yes, it's available." Nothing more. By then she already has a viewing time from someone else.

slides.heading: REPLIES IN **MINUTES**
slides.body: Confirms the apartment, shares the basics and offers Saturday at 10. She says yes. This agent wins.

slides.heading: YOU DID THE HARD PART. THEN **LOST** HER.
slides.body: Your post worked. She messaged you. A slow reply handed her to another agent.

slides.heading: SPEED OFTEN BEATS THE **BEST** LISTING.
slides.body: Decide now who replies, and how fast.

caption:
She messaged three agents about the same kind of apartment. Only one got the viewing.

It wasn't the agent with the best photos.
It was the one who answered first, with the basics and a viewing time.
A buyer who waits hours has usually messaged other agents by then.
More enquiries only matter if someone answers fast.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.

idea.title: Set up WhatsApp quick replies for listings
idea.angle: Say you get 20 messages a week asking the same things. Saved quick replies in WhatsApp Business let you answer basics in seconds and keep your time for real buyers.
idea.hook: STOP TYPING THE SAME REPLY 20 TIMES

slides.heading: STOP TYPING THE SAME REPLY **20 TIMES**
slides.body: Set it up once. Use it on every listing.

slides.heading: THE SAME QUESTIONS, **EVERY** WEEK
slides.body: Say you get 20 messages a week. Most ask the same things. Is it available? Where is it? Can I see it? You type each answer by hand.

slides.heading: SLOW REPLIES. **LATE** NIGHTS.
slides.body: You reply when you're free, so buyers wait. And you're still typing the same answers at night.

slides.heading: OPEN WHATSAPP **BUSINESS**
slides.body: Go to Settings, then Business tools. Tap Quick replies.

slides.heading: SAVE YOUR **TOP 3** ANSWERS
slides.body: Is it available, with the basics. How to book a viewing. Where it is. Give each one a short shortcut word.

slides.heading: TYPE A SLASH. **SEND** IN SECONDS.
slides.body: Type / in any chat and pick your reply. Add the listing name. Send.

slides.heading: LET QUICK REPLIES DO THE **BASICS**.
slides.body: Then add one personal line, so it never feels like a robot. Keep your time for real buyers.

slides.heading: SET IT UP **ONCE**
slides.body: Save this and set it up today

caption:
If you type the same reply again and again, you're losing time and buyers.

Say you get 20 messages a week asking the same things.
WhatsApp Business lets you save quick replies for the basics.
Type a slash, pick the reply, add the listing name, send.
You reply faster, and you don't work later.

Save this and set it up today.

idea.title: Posted once, in one place, then silence
idea.angle: One Instagram post and then nothing means most of your audience never sees the listing. It isn't a bad listing; it just never had a chance to be seen.
idea.hook: POSTED ONCE. THEN SILENCE. SOUND FAMILIAR?

slides.heading: POSTED ONCE. THEN SILENCE. SOUND **FAMILIAR**?
slides.body: It's not a bad listing.

slides.heading: IT NEVER HAD A CHANCE TO BE **SEEN**
slides.body: One Instagram post, then nothing. Most of your audience never sees it. They didn't say no. They just missed it.

slides.heading: GOOD LISTINGS THAT **DISAPPEAR**
slides.body: A day later, the post is buried. No messages. You start to think the listing is the problem. It isn't.

slides.heading: SHARE IT IN **FIVE** PLACES
slides.body: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, WhatsApp and property sites. The same video and photos, in the shape each one likes.

slides.heading: **REPOST** YOUR STRONG LISTINGS
slides.body: Most of your followers missed it the first time. Post it again, with a new first line.

slides.heading: POST **EVERY** WEEK
slides.body: A few good posts every week beats ten in one day and then nothing for a month.

slides.heading: YOU DON'T NEED MORE LISTINGS. YOU NEED THEM **SEEN**.
slides.body: Reuse what you already made.

caption:
You posted the listing. A day later, nothing. Sound familiar?

It's usually not a bad listing. Most of your audience just never saw it.
Share the same video and photos in five places.
Repost your strong listings, because most followers missed them the first time.
And post a few good listings every week, not ten in one day.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.

idea.title: Shoot listing photos with your phone
idea.angle: A recent phone works if you follow the rules: daylight with curtains open, clear the clutter, shoot from the corner at chest height, hold it straight, take upright and sideways.
idea.hook: YOUR PHONE IS ENOUGH. SHOOT LIKE THIS.

slides.kicker: FOR AGENTS WHO SHOOT ON A PHONE
slides.heading: YOUR PHONE IS **ENOUGH**. SHOOT LIKE THIS.
slides.body: No photographer needed. Just five rules.

slides.heading: BAD PHOTOS MAKE GOOD HOMES LOOK **CHEAP**
slides.body: Dark, tilted photos make rooms look small. The phone isn't the problem. How you shoot is.

slides.heading: SHOOT IN **DAYLIGHT**
slides.body: Curtains open, lights on. Late morning usually gives the most even light.

slides.heading: CLEAR THE **CLUTTER**
slides.body: Buckets, wires, clothes, anything personal. Clear it before you shoot, not after.

slides.heading: CORNER, AT **CHEST HEIGHT**
slides.body: Stand in the corner of each room, with the phone at chest height. The room looks open and true to size.

slides.heading: HOLD IT **STRAIGHT**
slides.body: Tilted walls make a home look cheap. Keep the walls straight up and down in the frame.

slides.heading: TAKE **BOTH** SHAPES
slides.body: Upright for Reels, Status and TikTok. Sideways for property websites.

slides.heading: YOUR PHONE. THESE **RULES**.
slides.body: Save this before your next listing shoot

caption:
You don't need a photographer. A recent phone is enough, if you shoot it right.

Shoot in daylight with the curtains open.
Clear the clutter before you start.
Stand in the corner at chest height and hold the phone straight.
Take upright photos for Reels and sideways ones for property sites.
Make it look good, and keep it honest.

Save this before your next listing shoot.
